scope: Read-only independent review of the training implementation, recorded experiment configuration, pinned XLM-R checkpoint metadata, and split/evaluation handling.

code_facts.architecture: XLMRobertaForSequenceClassification, 12 transformer layers, hidden size 768, vocabulary size 250002; four-class head.
code_facts.label_mapping_source: text_training.py constructs id2label from LABELS=(minor, serious, critical, needs_review), and label2id from the same tuple.
code_facts.full_backbone: --unfreeze-backbone leaves the model backbone trainable; the saved run metadata records backbone_frozen=false.
code_facts.optimizer_options: Code supports AdamW and Transformers Adafactor; optimizer choice is CLI-configurable.
code_facts.precision: CUDA training uses torch.autocast with GradScaler enabled; recorded metadata calls this cuda_fp16_autocast. CPU path is fp32.
code_facts.gradient_accumulation: Code accumulates microbatch gradients for the requested number of batches and normalizes weighted loss over the entire accumulation window, including a partial final window.
code_facts.gradient_checkpointing: CLI option enables model.gradient_checkpointing_enable(use_reentrant=false) and disables use_cache when available.
code_facts.checkpoint_selection: selection_key('balanced_safety') returns lexicographic tuple (-raw_high_risk_undertriage_count, raw macro_f1, min(critical recall, serious recall), critical precision). The raw high-risk undertriage count is based on argmax labels for serious/critical actual rows; needs_review is not ranked as a lower-severity class.
code_facts.early_stopping: Patience counts consecutive epochs whose validation tuple does not strictly improve. Best checkpoint is saved from validation only.
code_facts.test_evaluation_separation: run_train evaluates validation each epoch. Unless --evaluate-test is supplied it does not calculate test predictions/metrics. run_evaluate(test) requires the unchanged dataset fingerprint and saved test IDs; external evaluation rejects overlap with train/validation groups and normalized text.
code_facts.deployment_guard: Training/evaluation metadata always records approved_for_deployment=false; this code has no command that activates a model.

recorded_run_configuration.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU (4 GiB)
recorded_run_configuration.configuration_source: Current run configuration is confirmed by the current checkpoint metadata.json, report TRAINING_CONFIG.json, training history, and command log. Previous 724-row draft-checkpoint metadata is not evidence for this run.

tokenizer_and_length.warning_finding: Known Transformers 4.57.6 tokenizer-class heuristic warning was assessed as a false positive for the local XLM-R detector by the recorded probe; no unrelated Mistral fix was applied.

split_and_evaluation_findings.model_api_split: The training script consumes a compatible three-key manifest (train, validation, test); its test IDs are the separate fresh_test partition. Calibration and challenge are stored separately and are not in model_development.csv.
split_and_evaluation_findings.leakage_controls: The split preparation unions source group, scenario family, annotation group, parent-child links, normalized-text duplicates, and 19 AI-recommended same-scenario-family edges as indivisible components. It checks group/text disjointness between partitions and full ID coverage.
split_and_evaluation_findings.prior_exposure_limitation: The split manifest explicitly states that all 850 rows were previously consumed across model-development workflows. Thus the new fresh_test is held out from this run's fitting and checkpoint selection, but is not an independently collected or historically unseen test set.
split_and_evaluation_findings.current_training_vs_test: Training completed 8 epochs and selected the best validation checkpoint from epoch 6. Metadata records test_evaluated_during_training=false; training calculated only a length/truncation check and row count for fresh_test, not test predictions or metrics. The selected checkpoint was then evaluated on the frozen fresh_test partition (84 rows) after fitting and selection. Calibration (83 rows) and challenge (43 rows) have separate post-fit evaluation artifacts and were not used for fitting or epoch selection. Historical prior exposure remains as stated in the split manifest.

suggestions_not_code_facts: Treat this as a provisional, synthetic-data experiment even though the owner-attested batch is recorded as reviewed; the attestation is not direct independent responder evidence.
Report both raw argmax metrics and review-routed metrics. The balanced_safety selector intentionally ranks raw undertriage first and does not optimize calibration, coverage, or routed risk.
Keep the validation support sizes and previous-data-exposure limitation adjacent to every fresh-test result. Do not interpret thresholds as clinical or operational standards.

Do not promote or deploy based solely on full-backbone training or aggregate metrics; the prior run had poor critical recall and high-risk undertriage, so require the current run's frozen held-out evaluation and human decision.
limitations: The training corpus remains synthetic in origin. The approval record is project-owner-attested and is not independently corroborated direct responder testimony.
The family reconciliation recommendations incorporated into conservative split grouping were AI-generated and are not direct human semantic adjudications.

All rows were previously consumed across earlier model-development workflows, so this run fresh_test is held out from this run fit and selection but is not historically unseen or independently collected.
The 84-row fresh_test is small; especially language-specific and critical-class estimates have low support and should be treated as uncertain.
